classification.difficultyReason: Use equal opposite sides to form and solve two equations, then calculate area and perimeter.

content.prompt: Find the area and the perimeter of this rectangle.

spec.sourceRegion: Question 20 rectangle below the prompt on the left
spec.description: Unfilled horizontal rectangle with external labels centred on their respective sides. No arrows, ticks or supplied solution values. The decorative blue source outline is rendered in house black.
spec.mathematics: Opposite sides are equal: 8x-21=4x+7 and 2y-4=y+8. Drawing coordinates express the source arrangement and are not measurements.
spec.answerVisibility: Only the four source algebraic side labels are visible in the question diagram.

answer.short: Area: $700$ square units. Perimeter: $110$ units. Equal opposite sides give $x=7$ and $y=12$, so the dimensions are $35$ by $20$.
answer.worked:
Opposite sides of a rectangle are equal.
$$\begin{align*}8x-21&=4x+7\\4x-21&=7\\4x&=28\\x&=7\end{align*}$$
$$\begin{align*}2y-4&=y+8\\y-4&=8\\y&=12\end{align*}$$
$$\begin{align*}\text{Length}&=8(7)-21=35\\\text{Width}&=12+8=20\\\text{Area}&=35\times20=700\\\text{Perimeter}&=2(35+20)=110\end{align*}$$
The opposite labels also give $4(7)+7=35$ and $2(12)-4=20$. The area is $700$ square units and the perimeter is $110$ units.
